# 中央授品原生回归专用；人物作用域，只撤销本例复任引入的冷却与待授请求。
# TIMEOUT是借用前的原生剩余日数快照，ELAPSED是同一测试实际等待的总日数。
# 调用前置必须保证原任没有中央pending/phase；原有长冷却按真实经过日数保留，不按近期授职期限截断。
tca_test_restore_central_timeout_effect = {
    remove_character_flag = tca_merit_central_pending
    # 原任若也未入品，复任会建立零级准备；本例新建的请求取消时必须连同借用上限/路线清理。
    tca_merit_cancel_central_zero_prep_effect = yes
    tca_merit_cancel_central_zero_source_effect = yes
    tca_test_restore_central_timeout_only_effect = { TIMEOUT = $TIMEOUT$ ELAPSED = $ELAPSED$ }
}

# 同一冷却恢复，不取得中央请求所有权；供借用前可能已有真实pending的旧串行用例使用。
tca_test_restore_central_timeout_only_effect = {
    clear_appointment_timeout = yes
    if = {
        limit = { $TIMEOUT$ > $ELAPSED$ }
        set_variable = { name = tca_merit_central_remaining_timeout value = { value = $TIMEOUT$ subtract = $ELAPSED$ } }
        set_appointment_timeout = { days = tca_merit_central_remaining_timeout_days }
        remove_variable = tca_merit_central_remaining_timeout
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；输出旧零级事务提交前的实际人物/最高领主与阶段，避免输出整个世界scope。
tca_test_log_central_zero_migrate_effect = {
    scope:tca_mczm_actor = {
        top_liege = { save_scope_as = tca_mczm_diag_top }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mczd_native value = merit_level }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mczd_merit value = merit }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mczd_target value = tca_merit_central_target_value }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mczd_phase value = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = tca_merit_grant_phase } value = var:tca_merit_grant_phase } } }
    }
    debug_log = tca_merit_central_zero_migrate_diagnostic
}

# 测试报告者作用域；CHARACTER为借用前原任，TITLE/POSITION为真实中央职位对应键。
# 先精确归还中央头衔恢复直属关系，再只同步议会槽；不假定失职原任仍直属皇帝。
# TIMEOUT/ELAPSED沿用原冷却快照；前置须保证借用前无pending/phase，只撤本例复任产生的借用准备。
tca_test_restore_central_office_effect = {
    title:$TITLE$ = {
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_test_central_restore_title }
        change_title_holder = { holder = $CHARACTER$ change = scope:tca_test_central_restore_title }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_test_central_restore_title
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { cp:$POSITION$ = $CHARACTER$ } }
        assign_councillor_type = { type = $POSITION$ target = $CHARACTER$ fire_on_actions = no remove_existing_councillor = yes }
    }
    $CHARACTER$ = { tca_test_restore_central_timeout_effect = { TIMEOUT = $TIMEOUT$ ELAPSED = $ELAPSED$ } }
}

# 本例自建阳性对照人物作用域；无任命对照完成后，临时封闭实际任命四日中的其他部司继任。
# 每轮显式覆盖ready=0，保存原生冷却及日期；不改官品、余额、评分或原first快照。
tca_test_lock_merit_central_control_effect = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mc_control_lock_ready value = 0 }
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mc_control_unlock_ready value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = tca_mc_control_prior_timeout value = appointment_timeout_days }
    set_variable = { name = tca_mc_control_locked_date value = current_date }
    set_variable = { name = tca_mc_control_lock_owned value = 1 }
    set_appointment_timeout = { years = 150 desc = appointment_timeout_desc_refusing }
    if = { limit = { appointment_timeout_days > 36500 }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mc_control_lock_ready value = 1 }
    }
}

# 本例自建对照人物作用域；根据实际经过日数精确解除本轮临时锁，调用后删除全部私有变量。
# 返回expected及ready只用于立即读取原生值验证；缺本轮所有权不消费继承的旧scope输出。
# 断言失败也必须调用；最终人物通用回收前重复调用是无写入的幂等清理。
tca_test_unlock_merit_central_control_effect = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mc_control_unlock_ready value = 0 }
    if = { limit = {
        has_variable = tca_mc_control_lock_owned
        var:tca_mc_control_lock_owned = 1
        has_variable = tca_mc_control_prior_timeout
        has_variable = tca_mc_control_locked_date
    }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mc_control_expected_timeout value = tca_merit_central_control_remaining_timeout_days }
        clear_appointment_timeout = yes
        if = { limit = { scope:tca_mc_control_expected_timeout > 0 }
            set_appointment_timeout = { days = tca_merit_central_control_remaining_timeout_days }
        }
        remove_variable = tca_mc_control_prior_timeout
        remove_variable = tca_mc_control_locked_date
        remove_variable = tca_mc_control_lock_owned
        if = { limit = { appointment_timeout_days = scope:tca_mc_control_expected_timeout }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_mc_control_unlock_ready value = 1 }
        }
    }
    # 私有快照若不完整，不能伪造成功恢复；仍清除残留字段，由ready=0保留断言失败。
    remove_variable = tca_mc_control_prior_timeout
    remove_variable = tca_mc_control_locked_date
    remove_variable = tca_mc_control_lock_owned
}
